content.text: Analyze this Magic: The Gathering card image and extract the card information.

Close-up of the bottom-left corner of the same card. Use this close-up for two purposes: 1) Look at the far LEFT edge for the Planeswalker icon (five-tined glyph) to determine list_reprint. 2) Read the separator character between the set code and language code (e.g., 'WAR • EN' or 'WAR ★ EN') to determine foil status. The separator is either a bullet (•) for non-foil or a star (★) for foil.
